title: Volley Machine Readiness
description: The supervisor's verdict on one machine, published retained to volley/_system/machines/<name>/readiness by the supervisor only. The machine record is the machine's statement about itself; this verdict needs the supervisor's config and version, so it has its own topic. States only, never a secret. See spec section 4.6.15.

name.description: The machine's name (the topic's second-to-last level).

ready.description: true when no blocking check fails: the machine can run an agent (tunnel up or local, no failing block check, claude and bun on the PATH an agent gets, the supervisor's volley version, GitHub push access and Claude signed in). No doctor report yet: false.

reasons.description: One human-readable line per thing that keeps the machine from being ready; empty when ready.

drain.description: hosts.<name>.drain: the machine takes no new placements; its running agents finish.

max_agents.description: The machine's agent cap (hosts.<name>.max_agents; the supervisor's own machine: hard_ceiling).

placed.description: Live supervised agents on the machine, plus placements reserved for it that have not spawned yet.

path_ok.description: Whether claude and bun resolve on the PATH an agent's session gets: the non-interactive ssh PATH on a peer, the supervisor's own agent environment on its own machine; null when not probed yet.

requirements.description: What the supervisor requires of the machine, so its doctor can compare and provision.

volley.description: The supervisor's own volley version: a peer's must match it.

bun.description: The lowest bun version the supervisor accepts.

repos.description: What the supervisor expects of each repository's clone (spec section 4.6.15): its repos.<owner/name>.git_email, which the machine's doctor checks repo.identity against. Only repositories config expects an email for; absent when none does.

sharing.description: The supervisor's per-item sharing modes (spec section 4.6.11), which the machine's doctor applies to its own Claude profile.

heavy.description: Per lease pool that sets per_machine (or a per_machine_overrides entry for this machine): the leases the machine's holders hold, and the pool's per-machine cap (spec section 4.6.5).

per_machine.description: The cap in force on this machine: the pool's per_machine_overrides entry for it, else its per_machine. 0: no slot there.

usage.description: The Claude account the machine's agents run under (spec section 4.6.12: <acct>@<host> for a peer) and its 5-hour usage; null while unknown.

repos.description: Each repository by its GitHub owner/name (a supervisor before repositories omits it): every running wave's, and every one the machine's record reports (an older peer's single repo by its origin). A repository is judged on its own: a missing clone, a failing per-repository check or a tool its repository needs blocks that repository only, never the machine's ready; placement skips the machine for that repository's waves (spec section 4.6.15).

state.description: ready: a clone that passes its checks and has its tools. cloning: a clone being made. blocked: a clone that fails a per-repository check or lacks a tool. absent: no clone.

path.description: The clone's path on the machine, when it has one.

reasons.description: One line per thing that keeps the repository from being ready there (e.g. 'java not installed (needed by owner/name)'); empty when ready.

fetched_at.description: When the machine's doctor last fetched the clone.

eligible.description: Whether placement may put a new task there now: placement's own machine filter (ready, not draining, under max_agents, its own admission open, not overloaded, enough memory and disk, Claude usage headroom) under the supervisor's config; a heavy task's slots are shown in heavy.

ineligible_reason.description: Why eligible is false, in one line: the same text as the machine's placement candidate line without its 'ineligible: ' prefix. Required then, absent otherwise.

local_agents.description: On the supervisor's own machine only: its local_agents mode, whether the fallback profile is in force now (no paired machine eligible), and the closest peer's reason (spec section 4.6.15).

checked_at.description: When the supervisor last computed this verdict. It re-publishes at least every machine_down_after_ms, so an older checked_at, or a supervisor whose own status is not live, means the verdict is stale.
